action.objective: A complete broad-search over all legal White moves at depth 3-4 to retain the extra e5 pawn, develop the c1 bishop, and keep the king safe.
action.rationale: Phase=broad_search requires candidate_moves=[]. Black's d6 bishop now attacks e5, so the e5 knight may be challenged; a full root scan is needed before selecting a candidate. Budget: 3000 nodes for this broad search, keeping 2000 reserved for verification and 1000 for comparison.
